role: XCTest suite for AnalysisSummaryGenerator: diagnostic score ranges/clamping, headline verdict (recovery score vs diagnostic fallback), key findings, actionable steps, trend insight, explanation, probable causes, AnalysisSleepInput flags, English narrative scope and FeelingCopy medical-safety wording.
types: AnalysisSummaryGeneratorTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over AnalysisSummaryGenerator and FeelingCopy

units.does: Async per-test setUp: calls super then pinEnglishLanguage() so English copy assertions pass on any host language.
units.entry: XCTest: instance setUp() async before each test
writes: ud:AppleLanguages (via LanguageManager.setLanguage when host is non-English)
notif:LanguageManager.languageDidChangeNotification (posted by setLanguage, also in the registered teardown)

units.does: Builds TimeDomainMetrics fixture from rmssd/pnn50/meanHR (sdnn=1.2*rmssd, sdsd=0.95*rmssd, sdHR 3, triangular index 12).
Builds NonlinearMetrics fixture with the given DFA alpha1 and fixed SD1/SD2/entropy/alpha2 values.
Builds FrequencyDomainMetrics fixture with LF=800 and HF=800/lfHfRatio.
Builds ANSMetrics fixture with given stress index/readiness and fixed PNS/SNS/respiration/HR-dip values.
Builds an HRVAnalysisResult (window 100-400, 3% artifacts, 290 beats, now) from the metric factories and sets isConsolidated, isOrganizedRecovery and windowHRStability=0.04.
Builds a complete overnight HRVSession spanning the last 8 hours with the given analysis result and no RR series.
Asserts strong metrics give diagnosticScore >= 70 and, with no recovery score, analysisTitle equals ScoreVerdict(score: diagnosticScore).word.
